DELA CUADRA http: diJg.gov.ph OPINION NO. 05 JAN Municipal Engineer and Building Official Municipality of Maitum, Sarangani Province Dear Ms. Dela Cuadra: This has reference to your letter dated 20 November 2017 requesting for the Department's legal opinion on whether a sangguniang bayan member who is also a licensed civil engineer may practice his/her profession. Under Republic Act (RA) No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991" (LGC), a sangguniang bayan member is authorized to practice his/her profession subject to certain limitations as provided by law. Section 90 (b) is quoted hereunder: "Section -m. Practice of Profession. - (a) All governors, city and municipal mayors are prohibited from practicing their profession or engaging in any occupation other than the exercise of their functions as local chief executives. (b) members may practice their professions, engage in any occupation, or teach in schools except during session hours: .xxx Relevant thereto, Section 7 (b) (2) of RA 6713, otherwise known as the "Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees", provides that the public officials and employees, such as a sanggunian bayan member, may practice their profession provided that that such practice will not conflict or tend to conflict with their official functions. The relevant provision of the said law is quoted hereunder: "Section 7. Prohibited Acts and Transactions. — (b) Outside employment and other activities related thereto. - Public officials and employees during their incumbency shall not:

(2) Engage in the private practice of their profession unless authorized by the Constitution or law, provided, that conflict with their official functioas; or" Based on the foregoing, a sangguniang bayan member who is also a licensed civil engineer, is allowed to practice his/her profession provided that it does not conflict with their official function. Otherwise, for violation of the aforementioned laws, the concerned local elective official may be subjected to an administrative case as provided for in Section 60 of the Republic Act (RA) No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991" (LGC) and Section 19 of RA 6770 as amended, otherwise known as the "Ombudsman Act of 1990". With these legal precepts in mind, we hope that the Department has enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours: By Aut of the Secretary: AUSTERE A.
